title: Poetry Flower Chain
description: Celebrate classic Tang and Song poetry in an ink-wash puzzle arena—piece together famous verses around seasonal keywords like flower, moon, and spring.
controls: Tap scattered Chinese characters in order to assemble classic poetry lines matching the stage keyword.

zh-CN.title: 诗词飞花令
zh-CN.description: 国风水墨雅趣诗词飞花令：围绕花、月、春、风等诗眼连字成句，重温唐诗宋词名篇感受绝美东方意境！
zh-CN.controls: 按顺序点击散落的汉字拼接出完整古诗词名句，感受唯美国风飞花令雅趣。
